paragraphs.en: The little prince prepared for his departure by cleaning the active volcanoes that he used to heat his morning breakfast. He also cleaned the extinct volcano out of caution. These tasks, though routine, felt precious on his last morning.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子为出发做准备，他清理了用来烧早饭的活火山灰烬，还出于谨慎清理了那座已熄灭的火山。这些看似平常的任务，在他最后的一个早晨却显得格外珍贵。

paragraphs.en: He pulled up the remaining baobab shoots with a sense of finality, believing he would never return. Watering the flower for the last time brought him close to tears. "Goodbye," he said softly, but she remained silent.
paragraphs.zh: 他一把拔起了最后一株猴面包树，心中充满了决绝之感，觉得自己再也不会回来了。最后一次给花浇水让他几乎泪眼模糊。“再见了，”他轻声说道，但她依旧没有回应。

paragraphs.en: The flower coughed, not from illness, but to apologize. "I have been silly," she said, asking his forgiveness and urging him to be happy. Surprised by her lack of reproach, he stood there, holding the glass globe mid-air, confused by her quiet sweetness.
paragraphs.zh: 花儿轻咳了一声，并非因病，而是为了道歉。“我刚才确实有些鲁莽了，请你原谅我。”她请求他的宽恕，希望他能开心一些。他没想到她会如此平静地道歉，手中拿着那个悬在空中的玻璃球，一脸困惑地看着她那温柔而安静的表情。

paragraphs.en: "Of course I love you," the flower continued. "It's my fault for not making it clear before. But we were both foolish.
paragraphs.zh: “我当然爱你，”那朵花继续说道，“是我的错没有早点说清楚。但我们俩都太天真了。”

paragraphs.en: Try to be happy... let the glass globe be; I don't want it anymore."
paragraphs.zh: 试着开心点……这盏玻璃灯泡就让它吧，我已经不想再要了。

paragraphs.en: He protested about the wind and animals, but she assured him that a cool night would do her good and that she was a flower who could endure some caterpillars. "If not butterflies, then the caterpillars will visit me," she said. "You'll be far away...
paragraphs.zh: 他抱怨风大和有动物出没，但她保证凉爽的夜晚对她有益，并且她就像一朵花，能忍受一些毛虫的光顾。“如果没有蝴蝶来拜访，那毛虫也会来找我。”她说，“你可要远远地……”

paragraphs.en: I'm not afraid of any large animals; I have my claws."
paragraphs.zh: 我不怕任何大型动物，我的爪子可厉害了。

paragraphs.en: She showed him her four thorns naively before urging him to leave. "Don't linger like this. You've decided to go, so now go!"
paragraphs.zh: 她天真地展示了自己的四根刺，然后催促他离开：“别再犹豫了。你已经决定了要走，那就快点走吧！”

paragraphs.en: She didn't want him to see her cry; she was too proud for tears.
paragraphs.zh: 她不想让他看到自己哭泣，太要强了，不愿流露出软弱。
